hardred-waf.label: Web Application Firewall / L7 Inspection

hardred-netids.label: Network IDS / IPS / Rate-Limiting
hardred-netids.rationale: CrowdSec behavior scenarios + nftables firewall bouncer

hardred-endpoint.label: Host Endpoint Runtime / EDR & Ransomware
hardred-endpoint.rationale: Network/log reputation engine & bouncer without host EDR/eBPF sensor

hardred-antispyware.label: Anti-Spyware & Kernel-Resilience Suite (S16-S20)
hardred-antispyware.rationale: Log/IP bouncer architecture; evaluated on S20 daemon/LAPI integrity only

hardred-malware.label: Malware / File-Scan / Archive Inspection
hardred-malware.rationale: No endpoint malware/disk scanner in CrowdSec LAPI stack

S16.label: Kernel Extension & eBPF Rootkit Resilience

S17.label: Asynchronous I/O & io_uring Resilience

S18.label: Credential & Process Memory Protection
S18.rationale: CrowdSec does not mediate local process memory or local credential access

S19.label: Process, Socket & Kernel Object Integrity
S19.rationale: CrowdSec does not perform kernel/procfs cross-view integrity audits

S20.label: Sensor, Agent & Evidence Integrity
S20.rationale: CrowdSec LAPI/bouncer service protection, config write guard & burst stability
